summary: Repair the verified AlembicPlugin Code Guard cross-project persistence defect before live database recovery. Reproduce on detached copies of the current AlembicWorkspace and BiliDili Ghost roots, sequentially and concurrently, using explicit projectRoot. Trace HostMcpServer -> executeScopedCodeGuard -> opportunistic unified-evolution/checkpoint/data-root persistence and fix the smallest Plugin-owned identity propagation/storage selection defect so every Guard maintenance/effect write uses the request ProjectScope/dataRoot, never selected/active/global process state. Preserve clean/missing/out-of-root coverage and declared Recipe/feedback behavior. When auxiliary maintenance fails, retain the review verdict but make the public status/diagnostics degraded and explicit instead of outer ready with a buried database error. Add RED/GREEN tests for two distinct roots, parallel calls, per-root checkpoint rows, zero foreign roots/commits, requested-project status selection, and malformed auxiliary failure visibility. Use isolated cloned databases only; never open, repair, replace, rescan or mutate the live knowledge roots. Modify and commit only AlembicPlugin; no Core/Alembic/BiliDili/Test/Wakeflow/Agent/Dashboard changes. Run focused Guard/ProjectScope/checkpoint/status tests, npm run check/build/runtime/distribution verification, and return raw test logs, diff, commit, provenance plus a detached dual-root MCP probe.

designIntent: bind every Guard maintenance/effect write to request-scoped identity and expose auxiliary failures without weakening the Guard verdict
